# Earth imagery

Local copies from NASA Blue Marble (2002), 2048 × 1024. Imagery is a historical composite, not current weather.

- earth-day.jpg: https://eoimages.gsfc.nasa.gov/images/imagerecords/57000/57730/land_ocean_ice_2048.jpg
- earth-clouds.jpg: https://eoimages.gsfc.nasa.gov/images/imagerecords/57000/57747/cloud_combined_2048.jpg
- Source and credits: https://science.nasa.gov/earth/earth-observatory/the-blue-marble-true-color-global-imagery-at-1km-resolution/

NASA Goddard Space Flight Center. Images by Reto Stöckli (land surface, shallow water, clouds); enhancements by Robert Simmon (ocean color, compositing). NASA describes this imagery as freely available to the public. No NASA endorsement implied. Source JPEGs are unmodified; the game adds lighting, clouds and atmospheric effects at runtime.
